You might want to start by reading pp 295-6 of the 2001 distance sampling
book. The short answer is 'it depends'! Clearly, for species that prefer
flooded areas, you will underestimate abundance, while for species that
avoid flooded areas, you will overestimate abundance. Can you stratify
your area according to where is flooded and where isn't at the time of the
survey? Can the flooded areas be surveyed by boat?

Steve Buckland
